title: Design, synthesis, herbicidal activity, and the molecular docking study of novel phenylpyrazole derivatives with strobilurin moieties
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,16088-16096
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02377G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Wenliang Zhang, Xiaodong Jin, Wenwu Chen, Shulin Hao, Xiaohua Du
Phenylpyrazole derivatives were designed and synthesized to fabricate novel herbicides containing strobilurin moieties. Most compounds demonstrated good inhibition on A. retroflexus, which were speculated as PPO inhibitors.
